text: Thornflies we all always ask me walk van Cuavaa and Flacman as one of the great representatives of Sculpture. The former, his sliders were almost the first to break through the intensive routine of the world mixed Italian and French art which had descended from Bernent and his school. Thornalizes nobly asked in advancing this revoltion, and with them assisted in establishing the practice of sculpture upon true principles. (a. w.-r.).
